title: Schedule Note on the Fee Assessed at a Moved-Down Cleaning Level (Cleaning and Damage Fees)
content:
**Rule.** When a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report under review is held at a cleaning level whose entry gate does not list the incident category reported, it is moved down to the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category, and the fee assessed at the moved-down level is the flat fee of the level the report is moved to, rounded half up to the cent.

## Inputs and where they are read

- **The level held** — the fee level on the assessment record.
- **The incident category reported** — the category on the assessment record.
- **The level moved to** — the highest cleaning level below the level held whose entry gate lists that category.
- **The flat fee of the level moved to** — from the figures below.

## Cleaning levels: entry gates and flat fees

| Cleaning level | Incident categories its entry gate lists | Flat fee |
|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | food or drink spill; trash or debris; animal hair or mess | $25.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | food or drink spill; trash or debris; smoke or vape odor; animal hair or mess | $60.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | food or drink spill; smoke or vape odor; animal hair or mess; bodily fluids | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | bodily fluids | $150.00 |

## Where a held report moves, and the fee assessed

| Level held | Incident category reported | Level moved to | Fee assessed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | food or drink spill | Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | smoke or vape odor | Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | animal hair or mess | Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | $100.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | trash or debris | Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | trash or debris | Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | $60.00 |

Every row follows from the two tables above: the level moved to is the highest cleaning level below the level held whose entry gate lists the category, and the fee is that level's flat fee.

## Worked figure (hypothetical report)

A report held at Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) records a food or drink spill. The entry gate of Level 4 lists bodily fluids only, so the move is due. Below Level 4, the highest cleaning level whose entry gate lists a food or drink spill is Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant). The fee assessed at the moved-down level is that level's flat fee, $100.00.
